home.intro1: A production-grade frontend starter: Vite, React, TypeScript, Redux Toolkit, React Router, Tailwind, and i18next — with exact-pinned, supply-chain-audited dependency versions.
home.intro2: The "Counter" tab demonstrates client state with Redux Toolkit (slice, memoized selectors); the "Notes" tab demonstrates server state with RTK Query, forms with react-hook-form + zod, and a mocked API with MSW.
home.intro3: Both features double as living documentation: each feature folder has a README explaining its structure and rules — copy their shape when adding a new feature.
